name: UI Watchlists RC Gate

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  cancel_previous:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: true
          all_but_latest: true
          only_status: "in_progress"

  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      python-version: ${{ steps.set-python.outputs.python-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        id: set-python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest bandit
      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: '1.1.3'
      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: bunx playwright install

  unit-tests:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: python -m pytest -q tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/unit/test_ingest_jobs_batch_lookup.py

  integration-tests:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run integration tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest -q \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_batch_cancel.py \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_events_stream.py

  e2e-tests:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      TLDW_E2E_SERVER_URL: 127.0.0.1:8000
      TLDW_E2E_API_KEY: THIS-IS-A-SECURE-KEY-123-FAKE-KEY
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run e2e tests
        run: |
          bunx playwright test e2e/workflows/media-ingest.spec.ts \
            --grep "should cancel quick ingest mid-process with confirmation" \
            --reporter=line

  bandit-scan:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run Bandit
        run: |
          python -m bandit -r \
            tldw_Server_API/app/api/v1/endpoints/media/ingest_jobs.py \
            tldw_Server_API/app/core/Jobs/manager.py \
            -f json -o /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json

  slack-notification:
    if: always()
    needs: [unit-tests, integration-tests, e2e-tests, bandit-scan]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Slack Notification
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          steps: ${{ toJson(steps) }}
          channel: '#ci'
          message: 'UI Watchlists RC Gate completed with status ${{ job.status }}'
